statement_summary: Annual update of the Security Assessment and Security Plan including the Cyber/SCADA annex
Every certification letter statement checked against dated evidence
Annual risk assessment with the Rev. 3A threat scenarios; annual Section 9 criticality review
Risk acceptance authority; no High acceptance for uncontrolled-release risks
Security impact review and approval for every OT change
Written security terms and annual review for OT vendors
Unique accounts on HMIs; no shared operator account
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A Table 9.3b access control; Form 3 Q21)

statement_summary: OT remote access only through the jump host with MFA; view-only until MFA is live
Vendor sessions on demand, approved, recorded, reviewed weekly
Same-day removal of IT and OT access; change passwords the person knew
Default passwords changed before connection
Physical access limited to the card list; key register
Local control of gates and units first in any OT incident
Security incidents reported to the Regional Engineer under 18 CFR 12.10(a)
Suspicious activity to the FERC Regional Office usually within one working day; HSIN report
Annual exercise with law enforcement and emergency management
CEII and security-sensitive marking
CEII only in the restricted library; no general shares
OT devices wiped and destroyed with certificates
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A Table 9.3a system lifecycle; Form 3 Q19b)

statement_summary: PLC and HMI backups after every change, offline and in the vault, restore-tested yearly
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A Table 9.3a restoration and recovery; Form 3 Q16)

statement_summary: Permanent project records per 18 CFR 12.12
Control system computers for approved control work only
Annual awareness training; role-based OT training before OT access
Removable media scanned and logged before any OT use
Approved generative AI tools only; no CEII
No photos or public discussion of security measures
